messages.author: 5d074889c2204101
messages.subject: export correlation table after getCorrelation()
parts:
Hi all,
I wanted to export the correlation matrix obtained with getCorrelation() command but when I try something like this :
> corrCG=getCorrelation(meth_CG, plot=F)

I get :
> corrCG
NULL

(which is weird since I have a correlation matrix in R terminal...)
Any suggestion?
Thanks!!

Jonathan

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] export correlation table after getCorrelation()
parts:
getCorrelation() should return the results invisibly instead of printing them in an ideal world, but it is coded in a different way.
But the following should get you what you want:

cor(percMethylation(methylBase.obj))
